item: a PowerShell launcher row is never dropped and the 8-launcher test waits for the writers, not a clock
summary: PR #1887 shard 3 (run 42593941896) found 25 of 26 lines 30 s after eight pwsh launchers ended. The fixed 30 s look could not tell a row still in a cold deferred pwsh writer (up to two per launcher on a loaded runner) from a dropped one, and the script had three silent drops: Start-DeferredRow returning false dropped the row; the deferred child dropped it when it could not make or wait on the mutex; and one failed append was final. Now a row no writer took is waited for by the launcher itself with no bound (late, never lost); the child appends without the mutex where the launcher would, refuses a row cut short so the launcher never writes it twice, and says on stderr in fixed words (none of the row) what it could not write; an append is tried five times in 0.75 s. The pwsh tests wait until every process carrying the run's token has ended, then look once, so a missing row is LOST and a slow one fails as LATE, never mixed up; red before: a launcher with no writer to hand to now ends after the holder and its row is there once. Release line: on Windows, the launcher no longer loses a crash or exit record when several launchers finish at once on a busy machine.
